When the default spell is cast, it breathes fire in a cone from the player continuously pushing the player back.

'''Description:''' Mages used to carry the fire traps from the ruins in their hands, and eventually learning this spell. When casting Blazing Breath, there is no slowdown, but it continuously generates recoil during the casting.
